subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should that detection be limited to an explicit `skills check` or Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so the durable product boundary needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with clear remediation and exclusions for configured and trusted roots.

options.title: Startup Warning Too
options.body: Also warn during gateway startup, accepting more operator-visible noise and runtime filesystem scanning.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs rather than adding off-root discovery.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with clear remediation and exclusions for configured and trusted roots.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest history across the skills CLI, bundled skill-creator, and workspace audit surfaces involved in the product choice.
